title: ReleaseUsbOwnership
description: Releases ownership of USB controller from firmware driver. While most motherboards handle USB ownership release automatically (enable XHCI/EHCI Hand-off in BIOS), some OEM boards fail to do so (e.g. certain H110, B150, B250, Lenovo Q270). May resolve boot hangs or non-responsive USB keyboards/mice at boot. Not recommended unless necessary.
